title: DRAFTSMAN DETAILER
description:
Tabubil Engineering Limited is a major contractor to Ok Tedi Mining Ltd in Western Province of Papua New Guinea.  The company now has an immediate vacancy for a suitably qualified person for:
DRAFTSMAN DETAILER
Reporting to the Engineering & Technical Services Manager, you will be responsible for producing accurate and detailed technical drawings and models using CAD software in accordance with compliance standards. You will collaborate closely with project teams, incorporate feedback to refine designs, and communicate effectively across multicultural teams while addressing technical challenges essential to project success.
The successful applicant must possess the following attributes:
Diploma or associate degree in Drafting, CAD Design or related field
5 years’ experience in fabrication drawing; single-parts detailed drawings and assembly drawings
Proficiency in CAD Software
Strong technical drawing and design skills
Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication and teamwork skills
Experience working in diverse and multicultural environment
Possess Class 1-6 driver’s license
Must have proof of valid medical & police clearance certificate
Terms and conditions to be discussed with selected candidates during interview. Single status accommodation & messing will be provided on site.
Interested applicants who meet the above requirements are to forward their application together with current updated CV, work references, and certificates to:
The HR Manager
Tabubil Engineering Limited
P.O. Box 431, Tabubil, Western Province
